title: 25,014 Fans Witness Manipur’s First-Ever ISL Match as NorthEast United and SC Delhi Share Points
summary: A crowd of 25,014 witnessed Manipur’s first-ever ISL match at Khuman Lampak, where NorthEast United FC drew 1–1 with Sporting Club Delhi.
body:
Imphal, November 25, 2026: A historic football evening unfolded at Khuman Lampak Main Stadium on Tuesday as 25,014 spectators turned up for Manipur’s first-ever Indian Super League (ISL) match, cheering NorthEast United FC and creating an electrifying atmosphere throughout the game.

The match between NorthEast United FC and Sporting Club Delhi ended in a 1–1 draw, with both sides sharing a point in the landmark fixture.

Sporting Club Delhi took an early lead through Mohammed Aimen, who found the net in the 6th minute. NorthEast United responded in the 28th minute when Antonio Moyano scored the equaliser, bringing the home supporters to their feet.

Both teams had goals disallowed in the second half, but neither could find a winner as the match ended level.

Following the match, NorthEast United FC expressed gratitude to the people of Manipur for their overwhelming support, highlighting the 25,014-strong crowd that filled the stadium. The club thanked supporters for raising their scarves, singing for the team and backing the players until the final whistle.

The club described playing its first match in Imphal, in front of the home crowd, as a special moment and said the occasion reflected how football brings people together.

The sold-out Khuman Lampak Stadium and the enthusiastic response from fans marked a memorable milestone for football in Manipur, showcasing the state's deep passion for the game.
author: Mirror Lilong Desk
